<thought>We need to construct a retrosynthesis route JSON. The target molecule SMILES is given in the mapped_rxn from template_search‑1. The SN2 step (template_id 12345) breaks a halide and forms a C‑N bond, producing the target from a halide precursor and a nucleophile (likely an amine). The halide precursor itself is obtained via a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (template from template_search‑2) using the two precursors returned by apply_template‑2: “CC(CN1CCCCC1CC1CCCCC1)c1cccc(Br)c1” and “CCOCC”. We will retrieve the template_id for the Friedel‑Crafts step using the catalog search, then build the hierarchical JSON route and verify its schema.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
